name: German American Bancorp, Inc.
summary: German American Bancorp, Inc. operates as a financial holding company for German American Bank that provides retail and commercial banking, and wealth management services. The company operates through Core Banking, and Wealth Management segments. The Core Banking segment accepts deposits from the general public; and originates consumer, commercial and agricultural, commercial and agricultural real estate, and residential mortgage loans, as well as sells residential mortgage loans in the secondary market.
